prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Deliver ONE polished landscape 16:9 Chinese cultivation-game MANAGEMENT SUBPAGE ideal UI, titled “田地改造”.
This is what opens from the existing single-field main page's “管理田地” button. It must be visibly an operational subpage, not another field overview.

Input image roles:
Image 1: the existing v10 field MAIN PAGE, continuity/style and context reference. Same world, 一号田, target 月露苔, currently unplanted, ordinary soil. Do NOT copy its large field illustration or previous/next field navigation.
Image 2: actual 善功堂 screenshot, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Closely match its connected desaturated grey-brown wooden UI structure, matte depth, warm ivory paper insets, restrained blue-grey details and pale landscape wash in paper margins, readable dark ordinary Kaiti/slab Chinese, warm-paper framed buttons, subdued sage selected tabs. Do NOT copy its roof, pavilion background, hanging signs, tassels, flowers, shop counter, four goods columns or goods.

Purpose:
A separate “田地改造” child page for this ONE current field. Show how adding actual materials is operated: view existing inputs -> select an item from inventory -> set amount -> preview environment changes and remaining needs -> review actual inputs -> confirm.
Show the legitimate INITIAL state with no material selected yet. There are no defined material recipes, effects, quantities, costs or times to invent. The screen must still look finished and useful, not like a loading skeleton.
No gameplay numbers, no fabricated item names or inventory, no imaginary material effects, no corpse recipe, no soil-type package. Do NOT use the word 基质.

OVERALL LAYOUT:
An original near-fullscreen shallow connected grey-brown timber rectangular frame, warm ivory sheets inset, narrow desaturated blue-grey outer margin, readable restrained corner details, no scene background.
Top slim title/context bar:
Left context “瑶圃峰 · 一号田”.
Center paper title “田地改造”.
Right paper button “返回田地主页”.
No previous/next field controls on this child page; current field identity remains fixed while preparing a change.
Directly below header, a slim factual context row:
“目标灵草：月露苔” and “未定植” and “原有土层：普通土层”.
Then ONE horizontal navigation row of plain paper tabs:
“添加材料” (selected subdued sage), “控温”, “水分”, “光照”, “聚灵”.
These are sections in this operational subpage. Only 添加材料 is open in this image.
Body has TWO aligned functional areas: left about 52% width for material preparation, right about 48% for effects/needs preview. Shared timber divider. No giant farmland picture, no character, no multiple fields or mini-map. Do not waste space on decorative room/furniture.

LEFT PAPER AREA — MATERIAL OPERATION:
Main heading “材料投入”.
A compact first section with heading “已加入材料”, value “暂无”. It represents actual inputs already in the ground, not today's pending selection. Do not give this empty list a giant blank region.
Fine divider.
Second section heading “本次准备加入”.
A modest empty outlined PAPER ITEM SLOT with a plus sign, next to an obvious framed paper button “从行囊选择”.
A concise value line “尚未选择材料”.
Below a clearly labeled quantity control:
“添加数量” with a visibly disabled empty quantity field showing an em dash “—” and small disabled decrement/increment controls. The em dash is an empty state, not a number.
Small help line “选择材料后填写数量。”
Fine divider.
Third compact section heading “本次投入”.
Text “选定材料后显示用量、操作时长与费用。”
No numeric cost, inventory, time, coin or formula.
Toward lower edge of this left preparation area, framed disabled paper button “预览变化” and a small disabled secondary text control “清空选择”.
These are disabled because no item/quantity has been chosen, not because of an error.

RIGHT PAPER AREA — ENVIRONMENT BEFORE/AFTER VS NEEDS:
Heading “环境变化预览”.
Small quiet state “尚未预览”.
Clean readable table with FOUR columns:
“条件” | “当前” | “加入后” | “灵草需求”
Exactly five rows:
“温度” | “偏暖” | “—” | “凉润”
“灵力浓度” | “偏低” | “—” | “充足”
“水分” | “湿润” | “—” | “湿润”
“光照” | “直射” | “—” | “遮阴”
“土层” | “普通土层” | “—” | “阴湿岩面”
Make the headings and values sharp and aligned, fine horizontal rules, no dense dark spreadsheet grid.
All 加入后 values are em dashes because no material has been chosen and no preview performed. Do NOT fill them with improvements or arrows suggesting any material solves these issues.
Below the table, heading “当前缺项”.
Text “温度偏暖、灵力不足。”
Text “光照过强，土层不符。”
Then one subtle explanatory line “预览后查看改善项与剩余缺项。”
At the bottom of this SAME right paper area, one framed disabled paper button “确认加入”.
A short help line beside/above it “先选择材料并预览。”
There is no actual damage yet: this is an unplanted field. No stopped-growth/damaged badge, health bar, crop age, timers or harvest action.

VISUAL / SEMANTIC HARD CONSTRAINTS:
- This is a full separate management child page, not a popup piled over the main page, not two screens, not a storyboard.
- Make the actual operations clear and reviewable: existing vs pending materials distinct, item entry, quantity, preview, inputs and final confirmation.
- Root ground remains; adding a material does not select a preset soil profession or replace the whole ground automatically.
- No invented amounts, material names, eligibility, effect mappings, costs, inventory or duration. No actual recipe or remains illustration.
- Current state and uncommitted preview distinct. No previews or material slots have leaked onto the main screen because the main screen is not shown.
- Match the existing game's 木框/暖纸/灰蓝/楷体 family, with connected original UI framing, no copied 善功堂 roof or scene.
- Restrained matte hand-painted textures, consistent dark text and legible grey disabled text, no giant brush-calligraphy, gold glare, neon, bloom, glitter, fog or watermark.
- Render every specified Chinese phrase legibly. No developer annotations, example labels, debug notes or blank decorative cards.
Deliver the complete finished child-page ideal screenshot.
